name: client-handoff
description: Audits milestone deliverable files for integrity, scans for credentials, enforces root containment, and generates clean client delivery manifests. Compatible with skill: 'client-handoff' (.agents/skills/client-handoff/SKILL.md) for structured client packaging.

milestone.description: Name or title of the milestone or sprint deliverable.

client.description: Optional name of the client or stakeholder receiving the deliverable.

files.description: List of relative file paths within the workspace root included in this client deliverable.

outputManifest.description: Relative path inside project root where the Markdown delivery manifest should be written.
